source_name: Wikimedia Commons — Egypt awards category tree
scope_rule: Started at Category:Orders, decorations and medals of Egypt; recursively followed visible award/medal subcategories for Orders of Egypt, Medals of Egypt and their explicit award-family children. Excluded recipient/person/portrait branches, Ribbon bars of Egypt, Kuwait Liberation Medal (empty) and generic country-navigation categories.

category_pages.category: Category:Orders, decorations and medals of Egypt

continuation_boundary: All 16 visible category pages were fetched as HTML; no category pagination marker was present. Recipient/person branches (7 subcategories), Ribbon bars of Egypt (1 category with 77 files) and empty Kuwait Liberation Medal (Egypt) were recorded as scope exclusions rather than recursively entered.

image_audit.note: The file pages exposed original URLs, dimensions, uploader/author and license metadata. Original binaries were not substituted with thumbnails after Wikimedia returned a 600-second Retry-After; therefore no image is counted as visually verified or complete.

rights_and_licensing.source_rule: Licenses are per Commons file description page; category/footer CC0/CC BY-SA statements were not treated as a blanket license.
rights_and_licensing.observed_licenses: CC BY-SA 4.0, CC BY-SA 3.0, CC0/public-domain claims and Commons PD-self claims, as recorded per candidate in the manifest.
rights_and_licensing.warning: Object ownership, museum provenance and image license are separate fields; museum-context files remain subject to their file-page license/attribution and should not be labeled official Presidency photography.

failures.result: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; Retry-After 600 seconds. No local binary was retained, so no visual completeness claim is made.
Existing Presidency sweep had only site chrome URLs, not object media; this Commons sweep found related open candidates but no exact visible files for five of eleven families.

next_checkpoint: Retry only the 19 recorded original URLs after the Wikimedia rate-limit boundary at a low request rate. Decode and visually inspect each successful file; deduplicate Republic/Merit duplicate views before considering any normalized/public merge.
